fusions.name: Gallop to the Kill
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 8 tiles to the target and deals 13 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Stampede Wake
fusions.desc: A thundering circuit that deals 26 damage, ignoring armour, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you, and you move 25% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +6% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Gathered Momentum
fusions.desc: Each time you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
